results.approach: claim full formal verification from the finite-state checker
results.reason: The checker operates on equality classes and Boolean outcomes and has no refinement proof to Solidity, EVM semantics, parser bytes, or cryptography.

results.approach: formalize a next-generation protocol before a finalist exists
results.reason: There is no accepted relation, proof framing, arithmetic implementation, or security-qualified finalist to freeze as the target.

results.approach: treat separate Rust AIR and Solidity evaluator implementations as a single source
results.reason: Matching dimensions, comments, vectors, or tests do not create a checked generation path or semantic-preservation theorem.

results.approach: claim symbolic constraint completeness from mutation tests
results.reason: Finite row, limb, boundary, and corpus mutations provide useful negative evidence but do not quantify over all witnesses or selectors.

results.approach: claim a verified proof codec from strict readers and round trips
results.reason: No normative grammar, parser refinement theorem, exhaustive differential result, or adversarial resource proof is retained.

results.approach: claim Rust/Solidity equivalence from shared constants and vectors
results.reason: Vectors sample behavior and integrated proofs exercise selected paths; neither proves all field, extension, hash, transcript, AIR-fold, and codec arithmetic.

results.approach: select Lean, Coq, or Isabelle as universally superior without a target and team constraint
results.reason: All three can host a narrow target; library fit, extraction needs, reviewer expertise, and finalist semantics must drive the choice.

results.approach: include external cryptographic acceptance in the engineer-week sum
results.reason: Reviewer availability, theorem scope, findings, and remediation are unknown; the estimate explicitly excludes external acceptance.
The package executes only a local finite abstract model. H2/H3 hardware, deployment receipts, and public-chain behavior are not evaluated.
